name: Menahem
bio: Menahem son of Gadi marched from Tirzah to Samaria, killed King Shallum, and seized the throne of Israel, reigning ten years. He then attacked Tiphsah and its surrounding territory because it had not opened its gates to him, and in his brutality ripped open all the pregnant women there (2 Kings 15:14-18). When Pul (Tiglath-Pileser), king of Assyria, invaded, Menahem paid him a thousand talents of silver — extracted from Israel's wealthy men at fifty shekels each — to secure Assyrian backing for his own hold on the throne, and the Assyrian king withdrew (2 Kings 15:19-20). He did evil in the LORD's eyes like Jeroboam before him. His son Pekahiah succeeded him (2 Kings 15:18, 22).
